args.code:
import re, pathlib

root = pathlib.Path('servisler')
files = [p for p in root.rglob('*.ini') if 'yedek' not in p.parts]

def is_section(s):
    return bool(re.fullmatch(r'\s*\[[^\]]+\]\s*', s, flags=re.IGNORECASE))

def is_port(s):
    return bool(re.fullmatch(r'\s*port\s*=\s*5432\s*', s, flags=re.IGNORECASE))

def is_comment(s):
    return s.lstrip().startswith(';')

changed = []
for p in sorted(files):
    data = p.read_bytes()
    bom = data[:3] == b'\xef\xbb\xbf'
    lf = b'\n' in data
    crlf = b'\r\n' in data
    sep = '\r\n' if crlf and lf else ('\r\n' if crlf else '\n')
    text = data.decode('utf-8-sig')
    lines = text.split('\n')  # keeps \r at ends if CRLF
    in_veri = False
    new_lines = []
    for line in lines:
        s = line.rstrip('\r')
        if is_section(s):
            in_veri = s.strip().strip('[]').strip().lower() in ('veritabani', 'veritabanı', 'veritabani ')
            in_veri = s.strip().strip('[]').strip().lower().replace('ı','i').replace('İ','i') == 'veritabani'
        elif in_veri and is_port(s) and not is_comment(s):
            line = re.sub(r'5432', '6543', s, count=1)
            line = line.rstrip('\r')
            line = line + ('\r' if crlf and lf else ('\r' if crlf else ''))
            line = re.sub(r'(port\s*=\s*)5432', r'\g<1>6543', line.rstrip('\r')) if False else line
        new_lines.append(line)
        # fix: redo substitution properly
    # simpler: redo
    in_veri = False
    new_lines = []
    for line in lines:
        s = line.rstrip('\r')
        if is_section(s):
            name = s.strip().strip('[]').strip().lower().replace('ı','i')
            in_veri = name == 'veritabani'
        elif in_veri and not is_comment(s):
            m = re.fullmatch(r'(\s*port\s*=\s*)5432(\s*)', s, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
            if m:
                s = f'{m.group(1)}6543{m.group(2)}'
        new_lines.append(s + ('\r' if crlf and lf else ('\r' if crlf else '')) if False else s + (sep if False else ''))
        # handle \r
    # clean approach: work with explicit
    out = sep.join(new_lines)
    out_b = out.encode('utf-8')
    if bom:
        out_b = b'\xef\xbb\xbf' + out_b
    if out_b != data:
        p.write_bytes(out_b)
        changed.append(str(p))
    print(p, 'changed' if out_b != data else 'same', f'bom={bom} crlf={crlf} lf={lf}')
print('changed:', changed)
